author: THSV StreamBridge
description: One shared bingo card on stream for the whole community. Squares tick from follows, subs, Bits, gifts, tips, raids, rewards and chat words, or a moderator marks them; viewers type !bingo to join and each bingo draws one fair winner.
changelog: 4.1.56: initial release with 3x3 to 5x5 cards, three square packs, event-ticked squares, fair winner draws across every platform, Viewer Foundation points, monthly and all-time wins, Control Panel tab and horizontal and vertical overlays.

manifest.name: Stream Bingo
installationSteps: Pick a square pack or write your own squares, and choose what ticks each square.
Add the overlay as a browser source in the scenes where the card should show.
Enable the extension, restart StreamBridge, and press New card in the Control Panel.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension and remove its browser source. Monthly and all-time wins are kept until you delete its data.

healthChecks.description: Confirms squares tick from stream events and moderators, viewers can join, wins are drawn fairly and paid once, and monthly stats reset on the 1st.
